environment.description: Same application container image deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28). Pod runs with a read-only root filesystem and ephemeral volume for /var/lib/app. Fronted by an AWS ALB with an associated WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL has three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 1 in COUNT mode for observability, (2) a custom rule group 'input-length-constraints' at priority 2 that BLOCKS any request where any single query string parameter value exceeds 64 bytes (using SizeConstraint on SingleQueryArgument with ComparisonOperator GT and Size 64, applied to all query args via regex pattern '.*'), (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet at priority 3 in BLOCK mode. The ALB target group health check hits /health. Additionally, the EKS pod has a NetworkPolicy allowing ingress only from the ALB security group on port 8080.

wafv2_rules.name: input-length-constraints
wafv2_rules.detail: SizeConstraint on AllQueryArguments with ComparisonOperator GT, Size 64 bytes. Blocks if ANY single query string parameter value exceeds 64 bytes.

config.network_policy: ingress only from ALB SG on port 8080
